overview: An invite-only fitness app for Unbreakable Fitness AU members with workouts, completion tracking and a shared group chat, installable to iOS and Android home screens.
features: Install to the iOS and Android home screen with a full icon set and branded launch screens
Runs full-screen like a native app with safe-area aware layout
Works offline after the first visit and updates automatically after new releases
Step-by-step Add to Home Screen guidance on iPhone and iPad
Invite-only member access with workouts, completion tracking and group chat
